scope: Attribution and mechanism claims relevant to the native-resolution LiDAR lane. Owner statements and leaderboard rows are not treated as receipts.

claims.claim: The H33-2-B2 artifact earned the score value supplied in the prior brief.
claims.evidence_for: The attribution appears in user/owner-maintained material.
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: The GEMSDOE32 owner page describes the artifact as unscored and says no organizer score exists for its artifacts. No organizer submission-page receipt tied to the exact TIFF bytes or SHA-256 is present in this checkout. A public leaderboard row, even if displayed, is not an artifact/hash receipt.
claims.verdict: UNATTRIBUTED. Do not report it as a verified score or infer why it occurred.

claims.claim: Catalogue-adjacent pruning or sparse mass explains the H33-2-B2 attribution.
claims.evidence_for: The owner-maintained method notes discuss catalogue-aware pruning as a possible processing choice.
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: No receipt/hash establishes the score-to-file mapping; no exact bytes, controlled same-fold ablation, or organizer-labeled test set is available. Pruning can remove false-positive mass or remove useful prediction mass, depending on unknown truth.
claims.verdict: NO CAUSAL EXPLANATION SUPPORTED. The official metric's trade-off can be described, but it cannot explain this artifact's alleged result.

claims.claim: The prior H66 detector-arm scalar is a valid HOLDOUT-DTI result.
claims.claim_type: LEGACY REPOSITORY CLAIM; DISQUALIFIED BY AUDIT
claims.evidence_for: The raw legacy JSON remains in evidence for traceability.
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: The H66 runner uses distance to the full catalogue to select emitted cells before holdout scoring, so withheld positives affect candidate eligibility. It also scores beyond the LiDAR-covered validation mask, does not implement the required full-segment buffered protocol, and records no valid 95% CI for the level. The value therefore fails the user's reporting and leakage gates.
claims.verdict: RETRACTED AS A QUALIFIED HOLDOUT-DTI CLAIM. Raw evidence is retained but must not be quoted as a score.

policy: Report a research score only as HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive count, and a 95% CI. Report an organizer value only as ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED copied from a receipt tied to the exact artifact/hash. Projections, owner claims, and unreceipted leaderboard associations are not scores.
